initial.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished Chinese product documentation structure diagram for Neuink, a local-first research reading workspace. Wide landscape 3:2, high resolution, editorial information design, warm ivory background, deep ink navy typography, subtle sage green and restrained cobalt accents. Elegant thin precise connectors, generous whitespace, sophisticated flat/isometric paper-document mini illustrations integrated into nodes. No generic rounded-card grid, no gradients, no clipart, no mascot, no dark cyberpunk, no decorative meaningless arrows. All simplified Chinese text clean and highly legible, Microsoft YaHei / 微软雅黑 typography, no calligraphy. This is a real explanatory diagram not a product UI screenshot.
Exact heading: “文献与笔记，如何组织”
Exact small subheading: “Neuink 核心结构”
Hierarchy, top to bottom: top “资料库” with subtitle “文献与阅读成果的家”. From this parent two clear branches: left dominant branch “条目” subtitle “一篇文献”; right “标签” subtitle “一个研究主题”. Under 条目 three children “原始 PDF” / “解析片段” / “文档笔记”. Under 解析片段 two smaller leaves “片段笔记” and “译文”. Under 标签 a child “标签综合笔记” subtitle “整理多篇文献”. Illustrations may be document sheets, structured paragraph strips, notebook pages, simple tag tab, restrained and refined. Solid connectors show hierarchy ONLY. Do not connect tags as parents of entries in this diagram. Bottom exact caption “同一篇文献可以添加多个标签；来源链接让笔记回到原文。” No other text. Balanced layout with title upper left and diagram filling most area. Make this beautiful enough for a premium scholarly software product website, not a PowerPoint default flowchart.
